actions.title: Give each campaign mission an explicit wave cap or win predicate instead of the fixed zero campaign mode returns today.

Replace the raw key-code branches with input-action checks against the actions input_defaults already registers, and either build the referenced order routing or delete the settings rows that promise it.
Compare the truncation signature's line position against the diff hunk boundaries and block when they overlap instead of skipping every dirty file.
Reconcile the stale fifteen-to-thirty statements to the ten-mission lock or supersede the lock explicitly, then close the gap against the six shipped missions.
Freeze pipeline work for one release cycle and spend it closing an M4 gameplay item, then re-anchor the completion figure off what shipped.
Add an in-fiction subtitle under the victory and defeat headings naming the locked consequence on loss.
Change the draft modal title to the locked in-fiction header instead of the bare instructional line.
Refresh the production plan with a real drop-date column and either stamp the next batch's target or record the stall as a deliberate scheduling call tied to the milestone.
Swap both perf harnesses to WorldBuilder.make_directional_light and re-capture the baseline tables before any crowd-render default change.
Add source/Erik to the checker roots and the workflow path triggers, and add a glTF binary-signature check.
Add provenance rows for the ground texture, the displacement and rock textures and both logos, noting that the engine logo is a trademark asset rather than owner-made art.
Add a terror_relief branch to the support case in _on_building_placed.
Extend the round-trip test to snapshot all seven economy amounts, completed research, mods, command-post health and the enemy-field alive count.
Add a debug-flag-gated one-second sampler that appends frame rate and alive count to a rotating user-directory file.
Add infinite_resources to run_config and read it from there in economy.gd.
Have audit-silent-guards.ps1 write its findings to a rotating report file in addition to console output.
Add occupancy, footprint and map-bounds validity checks with a red-tinted ghost when placement is invalid.
Route both option-persist call sites through the same atomic write, verify and rename helper the run save uses.
Extract a migration dispatch keyed by save version before the save version is next bumped.
Clamp each run configuration field to its legal range before the world applies it.
Wrap the remaining player-facing strings, or record a superseding locked decision that formally defers translation coverage past v1.
Pass the authored mission name into the in-mission HUD banner alongside the number.
Throttle the nearest-enemy call, skip it while a move target is set, and fall back to a bounded nearest_in_range hunt radius.
Introduce a mission-keyed data resource that run_config and wave_director both read for objectives, layout and win predicate.
Record a locked decision scoping the v1 slice of the dispatch catalog, then replace the placeholder draft list with the scoped cards.
Extract _save_run, _load_run and SAVE_VERSION into a source/save/ script so the module boundary matches where the code lives.
Rename or relocate the source/Erik lookdev scripts under a lookdev subfolder so they cannot be mistaken for live gameplay code.
Add the upstream license text to the vendored addon folder or drop the addon from the tracked tree.
Record the display font's license, source and version, and commit the license text alongside the font.
Route the research panel through research.gd's try_start and unlock checks, or delete the dead surface and correct its header comment.
Check the legacy route's request logs, then delete the old worker and route once zero live traffic is confirmed.
Record the exact upstream release tag or commit hash this addon copy came from.
Cache the resolved scene and picked animation name per enemy type the first time that type spawns.
Add a combat-on row to the navigation harness that spawns defenders firing into the live horde and re-capture the table.
Map the difficulty percentage onto the five locked tier names and show the tier name in the sandbox interface.
Move the mission table into shared data so the world script can read authored names.
Point the crowd-renderer fallback material at a shipped texture, or carve this use out explicitly in the provenance doc.
Add a demolish action for a selected building that frees the node, clears its metadata entry and refunds through the existing ratio.
Give Hordes a scripts/sync-audit-dashboard.ps1 (mirroring Scheduler's) and have nightly-sweep call it after every audit, independent of release.ps1.
Republish code-audit's HTBH.md hazard file from personal-skills-src; the loaded copy still describes the retired pre-v0.98.5 2D stack with zero mentions of source/world3d/.

Re-run the auto-enqueue for the 2026-08-10 report's 187 findings, which never reached .work-queue.json at all; add an assertion that fails loudly when actionsOpen>0 but zero matching queue rows exist.

Add RULES rows for tool names, workflow vocabulary, assistant-chat phrasing, snake_case memory keys, and paren-quoted first-person directives to check_gdd_voice.py, seeded at baseline then ratcheted to 0.
Rewrite the three literal 'Claude'/'let me' phrases in docs/OPTIMIZATION_LOG.md, a tracked file in the public GitHub repo the voice guard doesn't scan and wouldn't catch if it did.
Install a real .git/hooks/pre-commit running the four integrity guards + voice check; add a -Message param to push-to-github.ps1.

Fix publish-gdd.ps1:431's idempotency check, which compares against an undefined variable and is unconditionally true, so every publish re-runs the full write-verify-retry cycle on the FUSE mount's top hazard path even when nothing changed. Add Set-StrictMode so this class of bug fails loudly.
Republish git-unstick from source; the live copy still names a nonexistent path (X:\HereThereBeHordes) and blind-deletes .git/index.lock with no Assert-GitSafe gate.
Route publish-gdd.ps1, write-dashboard-status.ps1, and sync-erik-branch.ps1's git writes through the now-existing Invoke-Git wrapper; only push-to-github.ps1 uses it today.
Have nightly-sweep (not just release.ps1) call write-dashboard-status.ps1 so the audit pointer tracks the report retention actually keeps.
Rewrite work-queue-runner's documented kind/project/status enums from the actual 24/29/5-value live vocabulary; almost none of the documented enum values match reality.
Copy finding evidence into the queue item at enqueue time; consolidate-audit-files.ps1 hard-deletes older report files with zero awareness of open queue items that cite them.
Merge three drifted bar-raise copies (bare user-skill dir, anthropic-skills plugin, personal-skills-src) into one authoring location; the other two should mirror it, not be separately hand-edited.

Decide whether the anthropic-skills plugin should carry Kane's custom skills at all; strip bar-raise/code-audit/handler-audit/project-canonical-audit out of it if not, since each currently resolves to two or three diverged installations.

Re-run the personal-skills publish for work-queue-runner and drift-auto-fix; the loaded copies are missing the mandatory queue-edit.ps1 single-flight lock and the finding_id dedup key despite a republish five days before this review.
Rebuild personal-skills.plugin from personal-skills-src (currently v0.1.0 on disk vs v0.5.1 in source); bar-raise, code-audit, and 3 other skills are missing from the intended namespace entirely.
Exempt the newest report of each type from retention pruning, or rewrite orphaned queue items' source field; 204 of 215 HBH queue items cite a deleted report file.
Requalify design.html and README's art-coverage claims to the measured roster state (most art still outstanding).
Rewrite the two GDD passages still using accuracy-adjacent Terror language, contradicting the project's own locked no-accuracy decision.
Wrap the index.html write at publish-gdd.ps1:498 in the same 5-attempt write-verify loop the gate page already gets.
Extend check_source_integrity.py's truncation heuristics to tests/*.gd and *.tscn scene files.
Add a terminal log entry to docs/3D-MIGRATION.md for the v0.98.5 retirement; replace its stale play_picker/save_load/mission.gd references.
Port BrackishRising's .last_released_version.txt monotonic gate into HBH's release.ps1.
Add -Message/-Version parameters to push-to-github.ps1 so commit messages aren't a fixed template.
Update .project-context.json's scheduled_tasks list from the retired audit-hordes-nightly/bar-raise-hordes ids to nightly-sweep/bar-raise-rotating.
Add a reverse pass closing/flagging non-terminal queue items whose finding_id has disappeared from the current run's openFindings.
Add a Step 0 freshness check asserting a canonical-audit artifact exists within the last 24 hours before a bar-raise proceeds.
Rewrite the three remaining 'the dev'/'per the dev' GDD instances to first-person or impersonal phrasing; add the pattern to the voice guard at baseline 0.
Delete three remaining 'happy to' clauses and ~20 bare we/our/we'll instances in the GDD; widen the guard's pronoun rule.
Rewrite ARTIST_GIT_GUIDE.txt to second-person voice, strip em dashes and the 'I'll chase it' line from 3D-MIGRATION.md, widen the guard's scanned-file list.
Add a per-project report-existence assertion plus a retry-once to portfolio-nightly-sweep's audit step.
The git-unstick source copy also never implements Assert-GitSafe in its actual Phase 1/3 logic, only in a frontmatter comment; fix the source before republishing.
Add a leaked-session reaper to nightly-sweep/bar-raise-rotating; consolidation concentrated the crash-budget risk into fewer, larger sessions.
Post the audit outcome to the Hordes Audit Bot webhook on every exit path, including zero-drift.
Rewrite the GDD's Vision pitch and section-4 opener to native-3D framing; they still read as a 2D isometric/hand-painted pitch.
Point the dashboard writer's backlog counter at the GDD's Backlog tab; the current variable is hardcoded null and always reports zero.
